description_en: Modifies the run epoch of periodic nodes, including image scan, emergency vulnerability scanning, and virus scan nodes
description_zh: 修改周期性任务的运行周期，包括镜像扫描、应急漏洞扫描及病毒扫描
name: ModifyCycleTask

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the configuration.
Call the [DescribeCycleTaskList](~~DescribeCycleTaskList~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
配置对应的ID。
调用[DescribeCycleTaskList](~~DescribeCycleTaskList~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: config_id

parameters.help_en:
The node name. Valid values:
VIRUS_VUL_SCHEDULE_SCAN: virus scan.
IMAGE_SCAN: image scan.
EMG_VUL_SCHEDULE_SCAN: emergency vulnerability scanning
parameters.help_zh:
任务名称。
VIRUS_VUL_SCHEDULE_SCAN：病毒扫描。
IMAGE_SCAN：镜像扫描。
EMG_VUL_SCHEDULE_SCAN：应急漏洞扫描
parameters.name: task_name

parameters.help_en:
The node type. Valid values:
VIRUS_VUL_SCHEDULE_SCAN: virus scan.
IMAGE_SCAN: image scan.
EMG_VUL_SCHEDULE_SCAN: emergency vulnerability scanning
parameters.help_zh:
任务类型。
VIRUS_VUL_SCHEDULE_SCAN：病毒扫描。
IMAGE_SCAN：镜像扫描。
EMG_VUL_SCHEDULE_SCAN：应急漏洞扫描
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en:
The unit of the scan cycle. Valid values:
day: day.
hour: hour
parameters.help_zh:
扫描周期的单位，取值：
day：天。
hour：小时
parameters.name: period_unit

parameters.help_en: The task start time, in hours
parameters.name: target_start_time

parameters.help_en: The task end time, in hours
parameters.name: target_end_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the task. Valid values:
1: enabled.
0: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否启用。取值：
1：开启
0：关闭
parameters.name: enable

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique ID for each request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
